intervention_dose: 1 mg IV step-up D1, 10 mg D8/D15 of cycle 1, then 10 mg q2w (28-day cycles)
population_detail: SCLC after platinum-based therapy and ≥1 prior line; ECOG 0-1; brain mets allowed if treated
median_dor_or_pfs: mDoR not reached at 10.6 mo follow-up; mPFS 4.9 mo
safety_summary: CRS in ~50% (mostly grade 1-2; grade ≥3 in ~1%); ICANS-like neurologic events ~10%; treatment-related AEs G3+ in 30%
notes: Pivotal trial driving FDA accelerated approval. Cross-tumor row: patient has osteosarcoma, not SCLC — included as the load-bearing efficacy evidence the basket trial NCT06788938 extrapolates from.

safety_summary: Confirmed CRS profile from phase-2; G3+ TRAEs 24% vs 53% chemo arm — favorable safety vs comparator
notes: Confirmatory phase-3 OS benefit in SCLC. Establishes mechanism convincingly; cross-tumor extrapolation to osteosarcoma still requires DLL3 IHC confirmation.

intervention_dose: regorafenib 160 mg PO daily, 3 weeks on / 1 week off
population_detail: Metastatic osteosarcoma after at least one prior line of chemotherapy; ECOG 0-1; adequate organ function
median_dor_or_pfs: mPFS 3.6 mo regorafenib vs 1.7 mo placebo
safety_summary: G3+ AEs ~70%: hand-foot reaction (predominant), hypertension, fatigue, mucositis. No treatment-related deaths.
notes: Small RCT with crossover; OS not improved (crossover diluted).

intervention_dose: regorafenib 160 mg PO daily, 3 weeks on / 1 week off
population_detail: Adult metastatic osteosarcoma after conventional chemo failure; French Sarcoma Group cohort
median_dor_or_pfs: mPFS 16.4 wk regorafenib vs 4.1 wk placebo
safety_summary: G3+ AEs in 76%: hand-foot reaction, fatigue, hypertension, transaminitis. Manageable with dose reduction.
notes: Independent French replication of SARC024. Two-RCT convergence is the strongest 2L+ osteosarcoma evidence base.

population_detail: Advanced osteosarcoma (n=42) and Ewing sarcoma cohorts; ECOG 0-1; adequate organ function
safety_summary: G3+ AEs 68%: hypertension, hand-foot reaction, hypophosphatemia, transaminitis. Thromboembolism in 7%.
notes: Pre-specified osteosarcoma cohort. Supports current AOST2032 phase-2/3 frontline trial. Reasonable 2L+ option in non-trial setting.
